integrity_note: The displayed algebraic proof establishes all-length statements; finite dynamic-programming experiments are corroborating checks, not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The fibre and code-size conclusions are relative to source words having at most four constant runs, not unrestricted binary words.
The four-deck upper bound on this family follows from the broader 2026 theorem for words with at most two runs of ones; no originality is claimed for that component.
The notion of fair words and known seven-letter nonpalindromic fair examples predate this classification.
An unindexed equivalent statement of the complete restricted three-deck fibre classification cannot be excluded.
title: Exact three-deck fibres for binary words with at most four runs
